risks.risk: Microwave magnetron may be weak/failing (heats slowly/unevenly) even if it powers on.
risks.proof: A short video of a timed water test in microwave mode (e.g., 1 cup water, start/stop timer visible).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven performance (worst case: reduced heating/needs service).

risks.risk: Grill function may not heat (broken heating element/thermostat) even if microwave works.
risks.proof: A short video of grill mode running with visible heat/browning (or a grill test item).
risks.if_unproven: Price as microwave-only / grill not working.

risks.risk: Door latch/hinge or seal issues can cause unreliable starting or leakage risk.
risks.proof: Close-up photo of latch/hinge + a video showing it starts reliably with door closed; ideally a leakage test report if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as possible door/latch issue (worst case: unreliable start).

risks.risk: Exact model/specs (wattage/capacity) unknown; affects market value.

proof_requests: Send clear photos of the rating plate/model number sticker (inside door frame or rear).

Send a short video: grill mode heating/browning test.

Send a close-up of the door latch/hinge and interior cavity condition.
response.reason: The seller asserts it was tested, but without new photos/videos the remote buyer still cannot verify that microwave and grill both work or confirm the exact model/specs and warranty evidence. Pricing must wait for operation proof and the rating plate.
